title: Sale mandate for Aurum
intent: You allow the agent's wallet to act for this account with exactly the listed permissions. You can revoke it with another DelegateSet carrying an empty Permissions list.

fields.label: Delegate (Aurum's wallet)
fields.hint: the platform's agent wallet — check it against the dashboard

constraints.note: The caps are the platform's mandate record, enforced by Aurum's scheduler — the ledger enforces only the transaction types.

warnings: A delegate can move funds within the allowed transaction types until you revoke.
Testnet only: LiquidGate refuses mainnet by construction.
